messages:
Eloise: kicking off quick bring-up for larkspur-emb-v1. focus: recall@1/5/10, short-query slice, int8-perchannel vs fp16, and cluster stability.
Mateo: datasets: wiki-2k, faq-1k, search-short(500). running a micro-run now.
Rohit: FYI did a tiny int8-perchannel test: overall Recall@1 delta -0.009 vs fp16, but short-query slice had -0.028.
Jin: can you paste the command?
Rohit: `./eval --model larkspur-emb-v1 --slices short,all --quant int8_perchannel --metrics recall@1,5,10,cosine_shift --out ~/runs/lark-int8.json`
Eloise: thanks. I'll queue full harness on staging-gpu-4. ops: start canary 10%?
ops-bot: Canary deploy started: larkspur-emb-v1 -> staging-canary (10%). watch 30m.
Mateo: early micro results from my run: fp16 R@1=0.670, int8 R@1=0.661 (-0.009); short R@1 fp16=0.64, int8=0.612 (-0.028). cosine shift median 0.012.
Jin: short-query drop is concerning. any collapsed neighborhoods?
Rohit: quick kd-tree check: ~9% of short queries show nearest-neighbor radius <1e-5 for int8, fp16 only ~1.5%.
Eloise: action items: 1) Rohit run int8-perchannel asymmetric + clip_scale +0.12 sweep, 2) Mateo add silhouette & neighbor-radius hist to artifacts, 3) Jin enable tokenization trace sampling for short slice. promote to 50% if short R@1 delta <0.015 and kd-tree collapse <1%.
Mateo: noted. uploading UMAP thumbnails and a csv of failing short queries to run artifacts.
Rohit: starting sweep now (staging-gpu-6). ETA ~90m. will post results.
Eloise: thanks — keep updates concise in this thread so product and infra can follow. :thumbsup:
